snippet.title: Thank You For Your Application - Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2881370/Thank_You_For_Your_Application/

Thank You for Your Application is an interview game. You play as a recent graduate who joins the Aeropolis Group as a recruitment officer.

Your job is to screen applicants’ CVs and issue rejection letters with various reasons. As you try to pass your probation period, you start to question your job and the monotony of corporate life… 

Meet the Dev (IceLemonTea Studio)
X: https://x.com/IceLemonTea2023
Bluesky: https://bsky.app/profile/icelemonteastudio.bsky.social
